name: Reap and Sow
detailed_description:
Reap and Sow is a unique choose-your-own adventure experience for PC, Mac, and Linux. Following your classic choose-your-own adventure tropes, Reap and Sow is a delicious visual novel aching for you to feast upon its story rich branches, grunge-like artwork, and distinct style.

College wasn't what the brochures made it out to be. After dealing with a crippling first quarter, the idea of a social life was out the window. That was until Julio and Lauren stepped in, having invited you to the biggest party of the quarter! Although, Things take an unexpected turn when they convince you to summon an ancient lust demon, whom seems to take a strange liking to you. Navigate a bustling house party, attempting to lure unknowing party guests as sacrifices to your new god. Who knows, maybe if you do good they'll keep you?

content_descriptors.notes:
Watch out for Sex, Violence, Death, and Demonic Subjects.

Reap and Sow is not for the faint of heart. The story you'll find yourself tangled in has depictions of ritualistic acts, sacrifices, and plenty of demonic nudity.

All depictions of rituals or darker magical subjects are fictional and not based off of real life.
